newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Rugby union-Ireland league division one fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Ireland league division one fixtures.

text.p: Saturday's All-Ireland league division one fixtures. All games start at 1430 GMT.
Old Wesley vs Shannon at Donnybrook
Old Belvedere vs Instonians at Anglesea Road
Terenure College vs Dungannon at Lakelands
Blackrock College vs Old Crescent at Stradbrook
Ballymena vs St.Mary's College at Eaton Park
Garryowen vs Cork Constitution at Dooradoyle
Young Munster vs Lansdowne at Tom Clifford Park
